nodes.title: Is the face 256 px or smaller?
Face features
widgets_values: List the visible features of the face and head in this image, such as the face, hair color, hairstyle, eye color and expression. Name only what the image shows, never what it lacks. Use short lowercase phrases separated by commas. Output only the tags.

widgets_values_named.instruction: List the visible features of the face and head in this image, such as the face, hair color, hairstyle, eye color and expression. Name only what the image shows, never what it lacks. Use short lowercase phrases separated by commas. Output only the tags.

widgets_values:
This workflow renders a distant figure with SD 1.5, upscales it 2x and then fixes the face. A small face from SD 1.5 comes out blurred and distorted.

1. Render: SD 1.5 at 512x768.
2. Upscale 2x: the image splits into 512 px tiles. Logit Tagger tags each tile and adds a place such as top-left to a tag that only one part of the tile shows. Logit Style Extractor reads the style from the prompt, or from the entire image when the prompt names none. Each tile is assigned a prompt of the style followed by its own tags, so that every tile keeps one style and its prompt names only what the tile shows.
3. Fix the face: Logit Image Check asks whether the image shows a face, and only an image it answers yes to goes on to SAM3 to find the face. Only a face whose box is 256 px or smaller is refined. Logit Custom Tagger lists the features of the face, and SD 1.5 redraws it at 512 px from a prompt of the style followed by those features.

Models: v1-5-pruned-emaonly-fp16, qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled in Load CLIP with type krea2, 4x-UltraSharp and sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.
